entities.summary: Jean-Marc Leclercq is a French singer and Esperantist from Toulouse. The former singer of the group Les Rosemary’s Babies who published two CDs with the French record production company Boucherie et Willins Production, he holds the Guinness Record for singing rock and traditional songs in over 22 languages. Jean-Marc Leclercq was a composers & musicians from Lille (b. 1961-10-10, Lille). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
